tw-mn-fergus-falls-trombler-1903.st: The local Ugeblad (1 Oct 1903) adds that he was a 14th Minnesota veteran who had come from Red Wing and lived alone after his bachelor brother died about 1901. The appraisers (J. A. Croft, E. S. Lambert and a Mr. McKinstry) found a pocketbook with about $87 and a $200 bank draft; 'an old trunk in a corner held $400 in gold'; a memorandum book held about $200; and there were two or three more pocketbooks and dollars in tobacco pouches, 'in all about $2,300', with the search still going on.
